evidence.name: CSS custom paint supported and Highlighter starts off
mode OFF preserves native selection and writes nothing
keyboard activation is visible and accessible
native pointer drag commits automatically, mode stays enabled
article DOM and sanitization remain unchanged
record has stable identity, article/subject snapshots and bounded anchor
palette has five fixed colors with a check and pressed state
touch handle adjustment resets completion and does not save prematurely
touch quiet completion preserves exact inline quote and future color
pen selection is pending while handles can be adjusted
multi-block pen selection paints one logical Range across paragraphs
repeat selection creates no nested duplicates
different-color overlap rejects without changing existing records
existing highlight recolor preserves identity
delete removes paint and retains tombstone
page reload restores paints and persisted active color
closing clears only paint and restores the mounted News list
reopen restores local records without extra publisher fetch
Save/Read state stays independent
no full body, HTML or extraction result is persisted
all five paint colors have readable 4.5:1 text contrast
Reader and toolbar fit viewport without sideways scroll
long article restores 82 saved excerpts and stays scrollable
